name: Meeting Participation
definition: Specifies the number of voting rights and of outstanding securities.

TotalNumberOfSecuritiesOutstanding.name: Total Number Of Securities Outstanding
TotalNumberOfSecuritiesOutstanding.definition: Number of securities admitted to the vote, expressed as an amount and a currency.

TotalNumberOfVotingRights.name: Total Number Of Voting Rights
TotalNumberOfVotingRights.definition: Number of rights admitted to the vote.

CalculationDate.name: Calculation Date
CalculationDate.definition: Date of calculation of the total number of oustanding securities.

TotalNumberOfSecurities.name: Total Number Of Securities
TotalNumberOfSecurities.definition: Number of securities admitted to the vote, expressed as a number of securities.

Meeting.name: Meeting
Meeting.definition: Meeting for which participation conditions are specified.
